text: The Fed has put rate hikes back on the table for 2026 while payrolls unexpectedly turned negative at -23,000 jobs — this stagflation-lite mix of rising inflation (3.5% CPI) and weakening employment means the safety net under stocks is thinner than it looks.
Adobe looks genuinely undervalued at a PE of 9.6 with solid 10.5% revenue growth and a 9.4% free cash flow yield — this is a quality business at a bargain price worth adding to.
GOOGL is trading 14.6% below its 52-week high with a reasonable PE of 23 and 15% revenue growth — this pullback in a dominant business looks like a good entry point to add shares.
